import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    
    dp = [0] * (n + 2)
    dp[0] = 1
    ans = 0
    
    i = 0
    while i <= n:
        j = i
        while j <= n:
            if ((i + j) & 1) == 1:
                ans = (ans + dp[j]) % MOD
            dp[j + 1] = (dp[j + 1] + dp[j]) % MOD
            j += 1
        i += 1
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
